items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: Fletcher says, 'Well, if you guys think he's good, I'll go listen to him,' so Fletcher did, and -- funny thing about it, John was a little reluctant to come in the band at that time because he was kind of afraid of Fletcher's book

ctx.x: Informed. I'm a little off. I've been up all day today. He would be informed of just what was happening and how the band was progressing on the arrangements, and all, and he said because we want to come into New York and cut these sides, and after I'd thought that the band was well rehearsed and we had the arrangements down under our fingers, so to speak, I called John up and I said, "John, I think we're ready." So he flew out, and he heard them, and he said, "Yeah, you are ready." So he took us to New York, took…
This was when? Do you recall?
